\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization [
  scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={min value=0,max value=10,ticks={step=2},grid},
  y axis={min value=0,max value=10,ticks={step=2},grid},
  visualize as line/.list={a,b,c,d,e},
  legend={north west inside,columns=3,max rows=2,right then down,label style=text only},
  a={label in legend={text={long gyjp}}},
  b={label in legend={text={$\displaystyle\frac{1+x_i}{1+x_i^2}$}}},
  c={label in legend={text={small},node style={font=\scriptsize}}},
  d={label in legend={text={$x^2$}}},
  e={label in legend={text={values at $x_i$}}},
  style sheet=strong colors]
data {
  x, y, set
  0, 0, a
  10, 3, a
  0, 0, b
  10, 4, b
  0, 0, c
  10, 5, c
  0, 0, d
  10, 6, d
  0, 0, e
  10, 7, e
};
\end{document}
